title: Mall world, the book store, the arcade
content: Constantly going to these places every single night. In the arcade I’m constantly playing the claw machines and winning almost every time, every other game is so boring and I’m just walking around. The mall version I’m constantly trying to shop and I eat etc pretty standard. Then the bookstore is most intriguing 🤨 I’m looking and looking for a certain book holding information I desperately need/wNt but have no idea what I’m looking for. Anyone experience the bookstore or claw machine activities?
